page.layout: One page with one table of calendar rows, read left to right across the columns Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ with Maii marks, then Christi. | Dioclet. Horizontal rules divide the rows into three groups. Running head above the table. Page number at top right. Signature mark at foot.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | Christi. | Dioclet.

page.notes: The Indict. column numbers and the Feriæ numerals are printed in old-style figures; the Nabon. year for the top row reads 1158 and the 1181 entry is printed as "ii.81" in the scan, transcribed as 1181. The 1181 cell is the least certain reading on the page. No other doubtful readings; the table has no Roman numerals to convert.
